About

International reach. Practical solutions.

Established in 2020 and headquartered in Arizona, Nioro Resources LLC is an international sourcing, trade and technology solutions company. Our network connects commercial relationships in the United States, Senegal, France, Italy and Turkey with sourcing partners in China. Our development department builds applications, mobile apps, websites and engineering processes.

Corporate profile

Our purpose

Connect businesses with products, technology, furniture and sourcing expertise across the United States, Africa, Europe and Asia.

Our ambition

Develop a dependable international business through sound commercial relationships and carefully scoped projects.

How we work

Clarity

Define requirements and responsibilities before making commitments.

Practical judgment

Assess each opportunity against its technical and commercial requirements.

Accountability

Agree deliverables and communication expectations at the outset.

A project-specific approach

Each project has an agreed scope, responsibilities and delivery terms. Furniture activities cover sourcing and procurement, not advertised installation or interior design services. Government contracting eligibility remains subject to verification.
